s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, a spoon of Dijon and snipped chives until smooth. Pipe back into the whites and dust with smoked paprika so they look speckled like eggs from a nest.
Peel 3 green plantains and cut into 3cm pieces. Fry at 165C for 4 minutes, smash flat with a glass and fry again at 185C until crisp. Toss with salt mixed with crushed garlic and lime zest.

m.note: the Costa Rican coast near Isla Sorna
m.how: Soften a diced onion and red capsicum in oil, add 300g rice and a can of black beans with their liquid and 500ml water. Simmer covered until the rice is tender, then stir through coriander. Serve topped with fried eggs and fresh tomato salsa.

w.note: the giant birdcage full of pteranodons
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Pipe into small nests and bake at 120C for 60 minutes, then cool in the oven. Fill with whipped cream and passionfruit and add three blueberries to each like eggs.

d.how: Pour 1L pineapple juice and 1L orange juice into a big jug. Scoop in the pulp of 3 passionfruit and stir well. Top with 1L cold soda water and plenty of ice. Pour into glasses while waiting for the rescue boat.
